items.answer: Two parts go into the Watchlist POC. (1) A rating notch calculator (REQ-06-02): given a previous and a current rating, it returns the notch change and the resulting WL. (2) The Indicator 12 country rating change WL (REQ-03-12). Other parts of the POC import both. Success: the four contract exports (RATING_SCALE, notchChange, notchCalculator, countryRatingChangeWl) behave as C1-C8 describe and `node --test` passes on the job branch.

items.answer: The analyst is the end user only indirectly: they pick or edit the previous and current rating. The direct consumers are other POC modules importing the contract. No UI and no role-based visibility rules in this slice.

IN: src/ratings/notch.mjs (RATING_SCALE, notchChange, notchCalculator -> {notches, direction, wl} with Indicator 13 thresholds, C2/C3/C5/C6); src/indicators/countryRating.mjs (countryRatingChangeWl -> 0|1|2, built on notchChange); unit tests under test/. OUT: fetching/pre-filling ratings from a public source (C4); override parameter, persistence, audit trail (C7); any UI/CLI/printed output (C8); an Indicator 13 function; other POC requirements; ratings outside the 19-step scale (rejected, C1).

items.answer: Yes. BBB+ -> BB+ = notches 3, 'downgrade', wl 2. BBB+ -> BBB- = notches 2, wl 1 (C2). 1-notch downgrade: calculator wl 0, Ind.12 WL 1 (C6). 2+ notch downgrade: Ind.12 WL 2. Upgrades/unchanged: WL 0 for both (C3); upgrades have negative notches, e.g. BB+ -> BBB+ = -3 (C5). 'bbb+' and ' BBB+ ' accepted, anything else RangeError (C1).

(a) POC example 'BBB+ -> BB+ = 2 notch -> WL=1' contradicts the C1 scale (3 notches); C2 overrides it: 3 notches -> WL=2, BBB+ -> BBB- = 2 -> WL=1. (b) Calculator uses the Indicator 13 thresholds (2 -> 1, 3+ -> 2), C2. (c) Calculator wl and Indicator 12 WL differ on purpose (1 notch: 0 vs 1; 2 notches: 1 vs 2, C6); countryRatingChangeWl derives from notchChange with its own thresholds and does not reuse notchCalculator().wl. (d) public-source pre-fill out of scope (C4). (e) 'editable' met by the two-argument contract (C7). (f) 'displayed' met by the returned object (C8). (g) upgrades/unchanged -> WL 0 (C3). (h) JOB.md 'tests under test/' and CLAUDE.md 'test/<area>/<name>.test.mjs' agree: test/ratings/, test/indicators/.

items.answer: Both requirements are Must; the contract is imported 'exactly'. Order: src/ratings/notch.mjs before src/indicators/countryRating.mjs, which is built on notchChange.

src/ratings/notch.mjs: RATING_SCALE = ['AAA','AA+','AA','AA-','A+','A','A-','BBB+','BBB','BBB-','BB+','BB','BB-','B+','B','B-','CCC+','CCC','CCC-']. notchChange(previous, current) = index(current) - index(previous), integer -18..18, downgrade positive. notchCalculator(previous, current) -> {notches: notchChange(...), direction: 'downgrade' (>0) | 'upgrade' (<0) | 'unchanged' (0), wl: 0 if notches<=1, 1 if ==2, 2 if >=3}. src/indicators/countryRating.mjs: countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current) -> 0 if notchChange<=0, 1 if ==1, 2 if >=2. Input trimmed, case-insensitive. Synchronous and pure. Unchanged returns +0, never -0.

items.answer: Every exported function throws RangeError when either argument, after trimming and case-folding, is not one of the 19 ratings: empty/whitespace-only strings, off-scale ratings (CC, C, D, SD, NR), other notations (Baa1), inner whitespace ('BBB +'), Unicode minus, and non-strings (null, undefined, numbers, objects) - RangeError, not TypeError, per 'anything else'. No fallback or default.
New build; src/ and test/ hold only .gitkeep. Contract names, paths and return shapes are fixed for future importers. No versioning (private, 0.1.0).

One component: library 'watchlist-ratings-lib' (javascript/node ESM). Code in src/ratings/ and src/indicators/, tests in test/ratings/ and test/indicators/. Owner backend, reviewer reviewer. No service, BFF, app, worker or database.

items.answer: Shared-library/domain layer. src/ratings is the rating primitive; src/indicators/countryRating.mjs is the Ind. 12 rule and depends on src/ratings (never the reverse). No API/BFF layer.
Plain Node.js 18+ ES modules (.mjs), package.json type=module. No npm dependencies, runtime or dev; nothing newer than Node 18 APIs.
Nothing is stored; pure functions, C7 excludes persistence.
No external system is called; ratings are passed in.
Synchronous pure functions returning plain values; ordering/idempotency not applicable.
No targets; a lookup in a 19-element table, no I/O.
In-process library with no dependencies or remote calls; nothing to degrade.
Only input validation: strict whitelist against RATING_SCALE after trim/case-fold, RangeError otherwise. Authn/authz belong to later callers/screens. No secrets.
Inputs are public rating symbols only; no personal data, nothing logged or stored.
No audit trail in this slice.
No logging, metrics or tracing; modules print and log nothing.
C2/C6 stand: the calculator uses the Indicator 13 thresholds (2 notches → WL 1, 3+ → WL 2); Indicator 12 keeps its own (1 → 1, 2+ → 2). The difference is intended.

QA re-checks every clarification example (C1-C3, C5, C6), invalid inputs and boundaries (0, +-1, +-2, +-3, +-18) through the public exports. No separate environment.
`node --test` must pass in full. No linter, typechecker or CI in the repo; no dependencies to scan. Commits carry no AI attribution.
Nothing is deployed; consumed by ESM import of the contract paths. No flags or migrations. Rollback = revert the merge (merge_mode local).
No separate documentation deliverable (no README/changelog/runbook); inline JSDoc is part of the dev card.
